subject: Verivaro G1 migration source and restricted bootstrap

requirements.required: Reviewer independently matches release manifest exact Git SHA, 63 locked migrations, transformed SQL digests, signed controls and reproducible CI report
Independent DBA approves cluster-global 21 roles, 3 segregated migration roles, dedicated DB CREATE scope, and role membership snapshots
Fresh install or existing install selected explicitly; existing history requires exact 63 source digests and ledger head without invented backfill
Named owner identity independently verified; owner Ed25519 key generated/stored outside GitHub and CI; signature bound to release sequence and SHA
Independent human reviewer identity and conflict-of-interest assessed; distinct privately held Ed25519 signing key; valid signature
Policy SHA-256 and minimum monotonic release sequence delivered through independently controlled channel, retained and checked for rollback
Outside-of-repository, independently controlled append-only ledger head receipt and monotonic release sequence witness, with tested rollback rejection
Production identity, secrets, TLS, backup, credential rotation, rollback/DR and operator isolation independently reviewed
Independent security reviewer signs off on SQL parser limitations, statement transformations, grants, ledger ACL, restore and failure modes

workflow: Prepare an unsigned release manifest bound to exact immutable Git HEAD and SHA-256 digests
Review privileged changes and approve one-time cluster-global bootstrap separately
Exchange and independently pin public keys and minimum sequence floor outside the repository
Owner signs exact manifest bytes offline with held-private Ed25519 key
Independent reviewer verifies originals and signs identical manifest bytes with distinct key
Verify exact signatures, policy pin, floor and source bytes using offline verifier
Independent custodian publishes monotonic witness and checks ledger head, DB identity and nonce
DBA obtains explicit change approval for any privileged provisioning; never automatically upgrade
Collect signed evidence, negative test results, restored DB outcome and final independent acceptance
